info.title: Trado Firebase Backend — Local Emulator API
info.description:
Authoritative OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract for the Trado Firebase backend.

**101 HTTPS Callable functions** across 28 domains.
**4 Firestore Triggers** (internal event-driven background automation).

⚠️ **LOCAL EMULATOR ONLY** — Targets loopback Firebase Emulator Suite (`127.0.0.1:5001`).
Do NOT use this contract against production cloud endpoints.

Generated from canonical source exports and validation schemas (105 total exports).
Input schemas derived from 90 Zod schemas via z.toJSONSchema().

servers.description: Trado API Explorer local proxy (routes to Functions emulator on port 5001)

tags.name: Triggers (Event-Driven)
tags.description: Firestore document triggers. These fire automatically on document writes and are not directly invokable over HTTP.
